input: Cancel unused gym membership this week

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The gym's cancellation policy and process vary widely — some require in-person visits, others accept phone or online cancellations — which determines the entire action plan.
Whether the user is still within a contract period or has a minimum notice requirement affects timing and whether fees will be incurred.
Knowing what cancellation materials or account details the user has on hand (membership ID, contract, payment info) determines what needs to be gathered first.
The user may have multiple memberships or add-ons (e.g., personal training, a family plan) — clarifying what exactly needs to be cancelled prevents incomplete action.
If the membership is shared or under someone else's name, a different person may need to be involved or authorize the cancellation.
The user's definition of 'done' matters — is it submitting the cancellation request, receiving written confirmation, or seeing the charge stop on their bank statement?
Some users want to avoid any confrontation or upselling from gym staff and would prefer a non-verbal method; others are fine calling or going in person, which shapes the recommended approach.

gold.taskTitle: Cancel unused gym membership this week
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to successfully cancel a gym membership they are no longer using, completing the process within this week.

questions.title: Which gym or membership provider needs to be cancelled?
questions.description: Identify the specific gym chain or provider so the correct cancellation policy and process can be looked up.

questions.title: Are you still inside a contract or minimum commitment period?
questions.description: Determine whether the membership is month-to-month or locked into a term, as this affects whether early-termination fees apply.

questions.title: Do you have your membership details and contract documents handy?
questions.description: Check whether the user has their membership ID, original agreement, or payment method details readily accessible before starting.

questions.title: Are there any add-ons like personal training or family plans to cancel too?
questions.description: Clarify the full scope of what needs to be cancelled to avoid leaving active paid components behind.

questions.title: Is the membership solely in your name to cancel?
questions.description: Establish whether anyone else is named on the account or needs to authorize the cancellation.

questions.title: What will make this feel fully done to you — a confirmation email, charge stopped, or something else?
questions.description: Define the user's personal finish line so the plan includes the right final verification step.

questions.title: Do you prefer to cancel online or by phone rather than in person?
questions.description: Understand the user's preferred method of contact to tailor the approach and avoid unwanted in-person upsell conversations.
